query: Workers pricing D1 pricing rows read written storage free plan limits
facts: D1 (Workers Free): Rows read 5 million / day, Rows written 100,000 / day, Storage 5 GB (total)
D1 (Workers Paid): Rows read first 25 billion/month + $0.001/million rows, Rows written first 50 million/month + $1.00/million rows, Storage first 5 GB + $0.75/GB-mo
Free limits reset daily at 00:00 UTC; monthly included limits reset on the subscription renewal date
No data transfer (egress) or throughput (bandwidth) charges for data accessed from D1
Storage is per GB-month across the sum of all databases in the account; tables and indexes both count
Indexes add an additional written row when writes include the indexed column
Read replication does not charge extra for read replicas
The Workers pricing page defers D1 billing detail to the dedicated D1 pricing page /d1/platform/pricing/
note: 返却チャンクに最終更新日の行が含まれないため、ページ宣言の更新日は取得できていない。
